purpose: Focused Ghidra closure for external state that can feed back into the player callback during normal simulation.

source.pipeline: raw NE segment import, Ghidra no-analysis annotation, Ghidra decompiler and listing export; NE relocation table only for call-site identity

scope.stopping_rule: Stop at a sound-only or presentation-only callback whose direct writes cannot feed back into the player record or callback globals; retain the address-qualified contract and unresolved indirect target.

functions.name: object_pool_factory_0E06
functions.calling_convention: far; AX=requested callback offset; ES:DI is the first-free pooled object on return; no caller-consumed flags proven
functions.inputs_outputs: Scans 0x40 records from DS:755E by DS:30CE stride. Initializes the first record with callback AX, +0x1C=0x1997, +0x28=1, +0x17=1, +0x12=FFFF, +0x1A=FFFF, +0x14=0; allocator failure enters a VGA error loop.
functions.scheduler_position: Inserts the new object into the active bank as phase 1 through 1036.
functions.object_effects: Creates a pooled object; caller selects the family/callback. Contact callers request 0x6328 or another explicit callback.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: indirectly; only if the selected callback changes player-relevant state

functions.name: object_update_pass_by_phase
functions.calling_convention: far; callback pointers are invoked with the pooled-object scheduler register/stack convention; no return flags are consumed
functions.inputs_outputs: Clears DS:88C8, toggles DS:7966 between bank offsets 0 and 0x200, walks the selected bank in phase order +0x17==0, then 1, then 2, increments DS:88C8 after each callback, and calls 0FDC before RETF.
functions.scheduler_position: First pass in the main loop. The bank is toggled before dispatch, so entries registered during a pass land in the alternate bank.
functions.object_effects: Indirectly invokes all phase 0/1/2 callbacks; it does not allocate or cull objects itself.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes; platform callbacks can publish DS:8812/DS:8816 before the later nonzero-state pass

functions.name: object_update_pass_nonzero_state_tail
functions.calling_convention: near from 0E96; walks the active scheduler bank; indirect callback return flags are not consumed
functions.inputs_outputs: Clears DS:8174, invokes non-null callbacks whose object +0x12 does not have bit 0x8000, and returns without a player-specific result.
functions.scheduler_position: Tail of 0E96, after phase 0/1/2 callbacks; separate from the main-loop 0FA2 nonzero-state pass.
functions.object_effects: Dispatches callbacks for active/non-hidden scheduler entries.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: indirectly

functions.name: object_update_pass_nonzero_state
functions.calling_convention: far; walks the active bank and invokes non-null callback pointers; no callback return flags are consumed
functions.inputs_outputs: For each scheduler-list entry with a nonzero callback pointer, calls that callback with the list/object context and advances by four words.
functions.scheduler_position: Second main-loop dispatch after 0E96 at call-site pairs 44FA/4518, 47FC/481A, and 4872/4890.
functions.object_effects: Indirectly invokes the player callback when its live object/list entry is present, as well as other callbacks.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes; this is the static ordering boundary that lets platform carry publication precede player consumption

functions.name: register_object_scheduler_entry
functions.calling_convention: far; ES:DI object; reads object +0x18 callback and +0x1C segment/selector word; preserves AX/DX return pair
functions.inputs_outputs: If object +0x18 is zero, returns immediately. Otherwise appends callback, +0x1C, and object offset at DS:7566+DS:7966, advances DS:7966 by eight bytes, and writes FFFF terminator.
functions.scheduler_position: Registration-time append into the current bank; 0E96 consumes the opposite bank after toggling.
functions.object_effects: Publishes a pooled callback into the phase scheduler.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes when the object is a platform or the player

functions.name: read_player_position_and_mode_39FE
functions.calling_convention: far; no explicit arguments; returns AX=player integer X, BX=player integer Y, CL=signed player +0x37 when DS:89EA==0; returns AX=BX=0 when gate nonzero
functions.inputs_outputs: Temporarily loads the persistent player offset from DS:881A, reads +0x37/+0x04/+0x08, restores DI, and RETF. No player/global write.
functions.scheduler_position: Called inside platform overlap A075 during the phase callback.
functions.object_effects: None.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes; A075 gates accepted overlap on its returned mode and coordinates

functions.name: update_moving_platform_9DC7
functions.calling_convention: far callback; ES:DI platform object; no caller-consumed return flags
functions.inputs_outputs: Rejects world/camera-outside objects through A06F; clears DS:5006, calls A075, stores player X/Y into platform +0x2A/+0x2C, integrates fixed-point X or Y velocity, tests MAP bit 0x0800 through 5DC3, snaps to 16-pixel boundaries after a block, reverses velocity at 9F35/9F4A or A03D/A051, then calls A0B2.
probe_coordinates: platform/player overlap: A075 uses returned player (X,Y)
horizontal MAP: (y, x+0x10) or (y, x-0x10) depending +0x4C
functions.scheduler_position: Runs in 0E96 phase order when its object entry is active; 0FA2 then runs nonzero-state callbacks, including the player callback when listed.
functions.object_effects: Publishes carry and toggles +0x59/+0x5A; no animation cursor advancement or platform-specific authored terminal table.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes; carry globals are consumed by the player callback

functions.name: platform_player_overlap_A075
functions.calling_convention: near call from 9DC7; input is ES:DI platform object and 39FE register return AX/BX/CL; no return value consumed
functions.inputs_outputs: If +0x58 is nonzero, decrements it and returns. Otherwise rejects signed CL<0, then accepts only object_x < player_x < object_x+signed(+0x3E) and object_y <= player_y < object_y+0x0C; accepted overlap writes DS:5006=FFFF.
functions.scheduler_position: Called before platform motion and A0B2 carry publication.
functions.object_effects: Uses platform +0x58 cooldown and +0x3E width; no allocation.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes through DS:5006 -> A0B2 -> DS:8812/DS:8816

functions.name: platform_publish_player_carry_A0B2
functions.calling_convention: near call from 9DC7; no return flags consumed
functions.inputs_outputs: When DS:5006!=0, DS:8816=((platform +0x04 - platform +0x2A) << 16)+1 and DS:8812=(platform Y - persistent player Y + 1) in signed 16.16; writes platform +0x5A=FF and +0x59=0. When no overlap but +0x5A==FF, clears +0x5A and sets +0x58=0x14.
functions.scheduler_position: Runs at the end of each 9DC7 platform callback, after motion and overlap testing.
functions.object_effects: Publishes/clears the platform carry latch and starts a 0x14-tick recontact cooldown.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes; 3FF8 consumes DS:8812 and 3A8A/3B44 consume DS:8816

functions.name: map_raw_block_test_5DC3
functions.calling_convention: far; AX=Y pixels, BX=X pixels; returns raw MAP word in AX and leaves ZF from TEST AX,0x0800
functions.inputs_outputs: Indexes DS:657A/657C with (Y>>4)*DS:657E + (X>>4)*2, reads the MAP word, tests bit 0x0800, and RETF.
functions.scheduler_position: Called by moving-platform 9DC7 motion branches.
functions.object_effects: None.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes for platform motion direction and snapping; no direct player write

functions.name: player_helper_5937
functions.calling_convention: far; caller input registers are preserved across the auxiliary work as observed at 3FF8; RETF at 5BED; callback does not consume a semantic return value
functions.inputs_outputs: If DS:85DA!=0, returns immediately. Otherwise compares DS:60D8 with DS:60DA, copies the new word into DS:60DA, dispatches each changed bit through 386F, updates digit/selector auxiliary globals from DS:881C, DS:8822, DS:880A, and DS:880C, and returns the final local value from the 880C path.
functions.scheduler_position: First operation at player callback entry, before DS:89EA transition-gate test.
functions.object_effects: Dispatches presentation/auxiliary objects through 386F and the address-qualified object callback at 0442; direct player/global transition write is absent.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: not through direct writes; indirect feedback remains limited to unresolved callback targets and camera/view globals

functions.name: publish_view_state_386F
functions.calling_convention: far; AX/BX/CX are forwarded to 0442; no caller-consumed flags
functions.inputs_outputs: Saves DS:817C, DS:81A6, DS:81AA, DS:81BE, DS:81C2; clears those view/target words; calls 0442; restores the saved view state and returns.
functions.scheduler_position: Indirect auxiliary dispatch from 5937 before player movement.
functions.object_effects: Calls the table-selected view/object routine 0442 while view globals are temporarily zero.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: no direct player feedback proven; view globals can affect later camera/render paths

functions.name: dispatch_view_object_0442
functions.calling_convention: far; stack arguments are consumed through BP-relative words; first dispatch selector is bounded to <=0x3E7; indirect object callback receives a zero argument
functions.inputs_outputs: Looks up a selector through DS:6D8E, indexes a 0x2C-stride table rooted at DS:6D8A, computes view-relative coordinates from DS:81A8/81AC/81C0/81C4, and invokes the table record callback at +0x18 when non-null.
probe_coordinates: view-relative object coordinates; exact stack argument naming remains address-qualified
functions.scheduler_position: Only reached from 386F/5937 auxiliary dispatch.
functions.object_effects: Indirect callback/object-table dispatch; callback target and side effects are not statically closed here.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: unresolved; no direct player/global simulation write is present in the recovered body

functions.name: map_raw_bit_4000_test_1C6E
functions.calling_convention: far; AX=Y pixels, BX=X pixels; returns raw MAP word in AX and ZF from TEST AX,0x4000
functions.inputs_outputs: Indexes the MAP by 16-pixel coordinates and tests raw cell bit 0x4000.
functions.scheduler_position: Player positive-mode alignment/contact helper call sites.
functions.object_effects: None.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes through caller flags

functions.name: map_raw_bit_1000_test_1C92
functions.calling_convention: far; AX=Y pixels, BX=X pixels; returns raw MAP word in AX and ZF from TEST AH,0x10 (word bit 0x1000)
functions.inputs_outputs: Indexes the MAP by 16-pixel coordinates and tests raw cell bit 0x1000.
functions.scheduler_position: Called by 3971/3986 vertical probes.
functions.object_effects: None.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes through ZF at vertical probe callers

functions.name: map_descriptor_quadrant_test
functions.calling_convention: far; AX=Y pixels, BX=X pixels; returns selected descriptor-quadrant occupancy in ZF after TEST DX,0xF
functions.inputs_outputs: Reads MAP cell low nine-bit tile ID, indexes DS:6582 by DS:30D4, reads descriptor +2, tests the low nibble selected by AX/BX bit 3, and returns through quadrant branches with the selected occupancy in flags.
functions.scheduler_position: Player side/vertical contact helpers and contact-effect motion.
functions.object_effects: None.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes through ZF

functions.name: map_descriptor_word_at_pixel
functions.calling_convention: far; AX=Y pixels, BX=X pixels; returns full descriptor word in DX; caller uses DX masks
functions.inputs_outputs: Reads MAP low nine-bit tile ID and returns descriptor record +2 from DS:6582.
probe_coordinates: MAP cell from AX>>4 and BX>>3, with BX aligned to an even byte offset
functions.scheduler_position: Descriptor response helper 3D02.
functions.object_effects: None.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes through descriptor correction branch masks

functions.name: load_animation_descriptor
functions.calling_convention: near/far leaf used with ES:DI object and SI descriptor pointer; no return flags consumed
functions.inputs_outputs: Copies descriptor words at SI and SI+2 into object +0x1E/+0x20 and +0x22/+0x24; selects object +0x12 from *SI+2, adding 0x32 when object +0x28 is FF.
functions.scheduler_position: Called by landing, contact response, jump/transition animation paths and effect callbacks.
functions.object_effects: Selects animation slot/cursor descriptor; no sound or allocation itself.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: only through player fields that later callback code reads; no movement arithmetic

functions.name: advance_animation_descriptor
functions.calling_convention: near/far leaf with ES:DI object; no return flags consumed
functions.inputs_outputs: Decrements +0x20 when nonzero; otherwise advances +0x24 by two bytes, follows negative sequence links, selects +0x12 with optional 0x32 mirror offset, and reloads +0x20 from +0x1E.
functions.scheduler_position: Common callback tail after movement/probe/effect dispatch.
functions.object_effects: Animation timing only; no simulation write beyond object animation fields.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: no direct movement feedback proven

functions.name: spawn_contact_effect_entry
functions.calling_convention: far pooled-object callback; ES:DI effect object; no return flags consumed
functions.inputs_outputs: Gates on DS:88AE/DS:880C and ring capacity DS:8808/DS:8806; installs callback 45AB, initializes effect velocity/fields, writes DS:612E=8, offsets Y by -15, and reserves a DS:87DE/87E0 ring slot.
functions.scheduler_position: Common player callback tail via 38EC; spawned object is scheduled through the pool.
functions.object_effects: Creates a short-lived contact/effect object; no solid collision query in initializer.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: no direct player simulation feedback; emitted effect/sound is externally visible

functions.name: update_contact_effect_entry
functions.calling_convention: far pooled-object callback; ES:DI effect object; return flags not consumed by scheduler
functions.inputs_outputs: Checks ring ownership, camera bounds, directional MAP/descriptor probes, reverses vertical velocity and advances effect state on a block, and switches callback to 470C when the ring or camera gate expires.
probe_coordinates: effect-side MAP probes around current +0x04/+0x08; exact branch order is in Ghidra listing 45E7-4670
functions.scheduler_position: Runs as a pooled callback after contact effect creation.
functions.object_effects: Maintains the transient contact effect and requests removal via 470C.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: no direct player/global movement write proven

functions.name: remove_contact_effect_entry
functions.calling_convention: far pooled-object callback; no return flags consumed
functions.inputs_outputs: Decrements DS:8806, clears the selected ring entry at object +0x2A minus the ring base, and clears object +0x18 callback.
functions.scheduler_position: Terminal effect callback; pool slot becomes reusable after callback clear.
functions.object_effects: Despawns only the contact-effect object/ring entry.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: no

functions.name: contact_child_callback_6328
functions.calling_convention: far pooled-object callback; ES:DI object; return flags not consumed
functions.inputs_outputs: Decrements +0x32; when it becomes negative reloads +0x32=8, invokes an address-qualified child animation/effect helper, increments +0x2E, and clears +0x18 when +0x2E reaches 4.
functions.scheduler_position: Phase-1 object created by 0E06 when requested by contact path.
functions.object_effects: Short-lived contact child; exact indirect helper remains address-named.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: no solid collision read proven; effect-only boundary unless indirect helper proves otherwise

functions.name: deactivate_object_outside_camera
functions.calling_convention: near/far callback helper; ES:DI object; no return flags consumed by 9DC7
functions.inputs_outputs: Clears object +0x18 callback and clears the ARE declaration high byte at FS:[object +0x1A + 1].
functions.scheduler_position: Called by platform A06F off-camera rejection and shared object visibility paths.
functions.object_effects: Culls/despawns the object and allows its ARE declaration to be streamed again.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: only through object lifetime; attached-player behavior after culling remains runtime-unresolved

functions.name: player_transition_branch_4416_44FE
functions.calling_convention: internal callback branch; no independent ABI; entered only when DS:89EA is nonzero
functions.inputs_outputs: Updates transition motion, tests the same vertical/hazard probes and response flags as the recovered callback, applies the transition decrement/terminal bounds, and returns through the callback tail.
probe_coordinates: same callback-selected probes as 3FF8; exact order is authoritative in player-static-decomp.cpp
functions.scheduler_position: Callback transition gate immediately after 5937 and before ordinary player input/movement.
functions.object_effects: May select transition animation/effect; no separate external gameplay object contract proven.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes while DS:89EA is nonzero; ordinary-level participation remains unproven

static_order.platform_to_player: When the platform is present in the phase bank and the player callback is present in the nonzero-state list, A075/A0B2 publication occurs in 0E96 before the 0FA2 indirect callback dispatch invokes 3FF8. A hash-pinned W4L1 follow-up captures the combined order, 3FF8 entry and near return, and complete 0x78 player records; exact scheduler-list membership and edge transitions remain open.
static_order.contact_effect_boundary: 41C1/41CF and 38EC->4519 are statically closed in the callback source; 4519/45AB/470C affect pooled effects and known globals but no direct player movement field.
static_order.descriptor_boundary: 1C6E/1C92/5C27/5CC3/5DC3 all have mechanical return contracts; gameplay labels for descriptor high bits remain intentionally unassigned.
